newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - Oct 15.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - Oct 15.

text.p: The New York Times reported the following stories on its front page on Tuesday:
- The Dow Jones industrial average rose past the 6,000 mark to end 40.62 points higher at 6,010 amid strong, bull market.
- Archer Daniels Midland Co has agreed to plead guilty to conspiring with competitors to fix the prices of two agricultural products and pay $100 million in fines.
- Moscow has begun to deport thousands of homeless people back to their hometowns.
- British designers have taken over creative control at French fashion houses Christian Dior and Givenchy.
